newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Sept 1996 steel output rises 7 percent.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Sept 1996 steel output rises 7 percent.

text.p: Mexico's September 1996 steel production rose 7.0 percent to 1.11 million tonnes from 1.03 million tonnes in the same period a year ago, the National Steel Chamber said Thursday.
The chamber said steel output for the first nine months of the year increased 9.4 percent to 9.77 million tonnes, from 8.93 million tonnes in the first three quarters of 1995.

Laminated steel production rose 11.5 percent to 820,389 tonnes in September 1996, the chamber said, compared with September 1995 output of 735,554 tonnes, according to the chamber. Output of laminated steel rose 20.3 percent in the first nine months to 7.50 million tonnes compared with the year before period.

"Continuing the positive progress of the sector, we forecast (output) will reach 13 million tonnes this year, a historical figure for the fifth consecutive year since the sector was privatized," Julio Villarreal Guajardo, chamber president, said in a news release.
"The stupendous development of the steel industry further commits businessmen in the sector, (who) will soon announce new investments for the coming years," he said.
